findings.summary: Imprint-year target lookup is duplicated across library result components.
findings.consequence: The same year-to-route lookup and guarded non-null route access must stay synchronized across result renderers; future changes to chronology route handling can drift between download, all, latest, browse, and source-download views.
findings.evidence: Line 32 starts a local computed lookup for props.imprintYearTargets. The same computed Map plus hasImprintYearTarget/imprintYearTo pattern appears in LibraryAllResults.vue, LibraryBrowseResults.vue, LibraryLatestResults.vue, and LibrarySourceDownloadWorkspace.vue, all consuming LibraryImprintYearTarget.
findings.recommendation: Extract a small shared helper or composable for LibraryImprintYearTarget arrays that returns hasTarget(year) and to(year), then reuse it in these result components while keeping parent target construction unchanged.
